privacyPolicy.metaDescription: CertiSen Privacy Policy — How we manage your personal data and your rights under GDPR.
privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy

controller.title: 1. Data Controller
controller.description: The data controller for your personal data is CertiSen, headquartered at 655 Av. de l'Europe, 38330 Montbonnot-Saint-Martin, France. Contact: certisen@inria.fr.

dataCollected.title: 2. Data Collected
dataCollected.description: When you use the contact form on our website, we collect the following personal data:
dataCollected.mandatory: Fields marked with an asterisk are mandatory. Without this information, we will not be able to process your request.

purposes.title: 3. Purposes of Processing
purposes.description: Your personal data is collected for the following purposes:

items.respond: Responding to your information or contact requests
items.manage: Managing the business relationship and following up on your inquiries

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.description: The processing of your data is based on your consent (Article 6.1.a of GDPR), which you provide by submitting the contact form, as well as on the legitimate interest of CertiSen to respond to received inquiries (Article 6.1.f of GDPR).

recipients.title: 5. Data Recipients
recipients.description: Your personal data is intended solely for CertiSen's internal departments authorized to handle your request. It is not shared with any third parties or commercial partners, except as required by law.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention Period
retention.description: Your personal data is retained for 3 years from your last contact with CertiSen. After this period, your data is deleted or anonymized.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.description: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

items.access: Right of access: obtain confirmation that your data is being processed and receive a copy
items.rectification: Right to rectification: request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
items.erasure: Right to erasure: request deletion of your data in cases provided by regulation
items.restriction: Right to restriction of processing: request suspension of data processing in certain circumstances
items.portability: Right to data portability: receive your data in a structured, commonly used format
items.opposition: Right to object: object to the processing of your data on legitimate grounds

rights.howTo: To exercise these rights, you may contact us by email at: certisen@inria.fr, specifying your request and attaching a copy of a proof of identity. We commit to responding within one month of receiving your request.

complaint.title: 8. Filing a Complaint
complaint.description: If you believe, after contacting us, that your data protection rights have not been respected, you may file a complaint with the French Data Protection Authority (CNIL): www.cnil.fr, or with your local supervisory authority.

cookies.title: 9. Cookies
cookies.description: Our website uses strictly necessary cookies for its operation and analytics cookies (Vercel Analytics) for audience measurement. No advertising or commercial tracking cookies are used.

updates.title: 10. Changes to this Privacy Policy
updates.description: CertiSen reserves the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. Any changes will be published on this page with a revised update date.
